title: Texas death row convictions partly based on hypnotic regression

tellings.quote: two guys on death row right now in Texas

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, passes on what his guest John Blitch, a scientist, told him: that two men are on death row in Texas right now whose convictions rested partly on hypnotic regression. That is a technique where a person is hypnotised to bring back memories they supposedly cannot recall. The point is that courts have trusted this method, which is also how many abduction memories are recovered.
